_: tools/build_topics.py: sets of words that belong together and are taught together (the owner, 2026-10-01: "I saw tarelka (plate) by itself but not spoon knife fork glass napkin… Same as autumn fall spring summer… the main words of a grouping should always be taught in groups"). The first unit on the route that teaches any member of a set teaches all of them; a member already taught earlier stays where it is. `members` are bare dictionary forms; `quiet` members belong to the set but do not start it on their own, because they have another common meaning (среда is Wednesday and 'environment'). `pos` names the class meant where a spelling has two («голубой» is the adjective 'light blue', not the noun). `home` is the unit that teaches a set no member of which has started it by then. `unit` pins a set to one unit whatever starts it: «мама» and «папа» are the cast's own words and every conversation uses them, and a conversation may only use the main path's words, so their set is chapter 1's. A member outside the word pool is brought in from the lexicon, as a reader's keep is. Each set is meant to be the core of its group, not everything in it.
